events.content: Reviewed two new PR 3125 threads. One identified per-test TemporaryDirectory overhead. The other found the PR description no longer matched fail-on-attribution behavior.

Added a failing regression, then replaced each temporary directory with a UUID trace path directly under the system temp directory. The path is Windows-safe and removed after attribution, including pytest.fail paths.
Verification: uv run pytest tests/ -x -q completed with 14362 passed. The focused 34-test contract suite, Ruff, mypy, Python 3.10 syntax validation, security scan, and independent review passed.
